scenes.headline: How a coding agent reads a binary with REA
scenes.sub: One MCP server, three disassemblers, and a receipt for every answer
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Shim! Today, how REA lets a coding agent take apart a program it has no source for.

scenes.text: REA puts Hopper, Ghidra and its own parsers behind one MCP server, and every result comes back with the evidence it rests on.
scenes.say: REA puts real disassemblers behind one tool server, and every answer comes back with its evidence.

steps.say: Your agent talks to one server, REA, like any other tool.
For machine code, REA starts Hopper or Ghidra with its own script inside, answering over a private socket.
Electron apps and dot net assemblies need no engine. REA parses them, and never runs them.
Every result is filed with the target's hash, addresses and limits, under an id made from its content.
Here it is in Hopper. Analysis finishes, then REA's bootstrap script starts, and the agent's questions arrive through the socket.

left.title: Decompiler view
left.say: In DX-Ball, the decompiler said this function takes nothing and does nothing.

right.title: Instruction view
right.say: The instructions showed an input, three float steps and a conversion. That disagreement kept the agent digging.

scenes.title: The sound-pan helper, recovered
scenes.say: The caller and the constants give the whole function.

parts.note: x is a brick's screen position
parts.say: A brick's screen position, times one point five six two five.
Minus five hundred centres the screen on zero.
Then a stored scale. A stereo pan.

scenes.title: From evidence to checked C
scenes.say: Then it has to survive a test.

items.say: The names are the project's. The binary has none.
Every position at five scales, original against the C.
Built with the nineteen ninety six compiler, the bytes match.

scenes.label: IPC bridges found in my test app after esbuild minify
scenes.say: One caution. On readable Electron code REA traced every channel. Minified, it found none, and said nothing.

scenes.text: The receipt proves what the tool saw. Checking what the agent concludes from it is still your job.

One server, many engines, and evidence you can audit.
